goal: Test observable feature capture and abstention on public production source; do not infer team policy authority or benchmark developer quality.
checks: Pin exact analyzed Git SHA and per-file SHA256.
Record every parse failure and omitted source path.
Compare declaration/equality/braces counters with a separately implemented ESTree visitor (Espree for JS; typescript-eslint for TS, same underlying TS parser for TS).
Compare emitted candidate parameters against measured counts and fixed thresholds; never label a candidate a confirmed convention.
Count default advice to reveal potential noise on legacy source.
Preserve all failures/abstentions; do not change selection or thresholds after observing outputs.
limitations: Repository sample is purposive, not random; no statistical or general accuracy claim.
No claim about actual team conventions without approved documents.
No runtime/build/typecheck and no whole-repository acceptance.
